description: This file defines a centralized application theme for a Flutter app, utilizing Material 3 design principles. It includes color palette definitions, a color scheme, and styling for various UI components such as app bar, buttons, input fields, and more, tailored for a minimalist oceaan-inspired aesthetic.

classes.name: AppTheme
